summary: Tested DealLinked CRM changes: Pipeline card styling, Map markers (teardrop SVG), Portal Deal Detail page (agent sidebar, documents section, interactive map), Backend contact fields, and Portal agent data API. All features verified working correctly.

backend_portal_agent_data.details: Returns agent object with full_name, email, phone, avatar_url, company. Verified via curl and pytest.

backend_contact_new_fields.details: Accepts new fields: title, owner_address, contact_types (array), asset_type_focus (array), markets (array), lead_source. All fields saved correctly.

pipeline_card_styling.details: Pipeline cards have marginBottom: 12px and border: 1px solid. Code verified at /app/frontend/src/pages/Pipeline.js lines 57-61.

map_markers_teardrop.details: Main MapView uses teardrop/pin shaped SVG markers (28x36 viewBox). Code at /app/frontend/src/pages/MapView.js DealMarker component lines 252-295.

portal_map_markers_teardrop.details: PortalMap uses teardrop/pin shaped SVG markers (28x36 viewBox). Code at /app/frontend/src/pages/PortalMap.js lines 162-165.

portal_deal_detail_agent_sidebar.details: Agent sidebar shows agent name, email, avatar placeholder, and Contact Agent button. data-testid='agent-email' and data-testid='contact-agent-btn' found.

portal_deal_detail_documents_section.details: Documents section always visible. Shows 'No documents available for this property.' when empty.

portal_deal_detail_interactive_map.details: Interactive map with teardrop marker shown at bottom of deal detail page when deal has coordinates.

portal_deal_detail_no_owner_id.details: owner_id is NOT exposed in portal deal detail API response or UI.

critical_code_review_comments: PortalDealDetail.js: Well-structured two-column layout with agent sidebar on right, property details/docs/map on left
MapView.js DealMarker: Clean teardrop SVG implementation with hover effects and ground shadow
portal_investor.py: Correctly fetches owner profile as agent data without exposing owner_id
contacts.py: ContactCreate model properly includes all new fields with correct types (List[str] for arrays)
